unresolved.what: Northern, Kassala (with Red Sea from 1973-01-01), Khartoum and Blue Nile provinces (1948–1974), their 1974 successors (Northern, Nile, Kassala, Red Sea, Khartoum, El Gezira, White Nile, Blue Nile) and the Northern, Eastern, Central and Khartoum states of 1991–94
unresolved.why: The 1991–94 lines drawn by the CIA 1994 map differ from the 2020 state lines by far more than its registration error around Khartoum and the Butana: Northern state's eastern line ran roughly 40 km east of the Nile south of Atbara, while today's River Nile reaches the Atbara river; Khartoum extended further east of the Blue Nile. The areas say the same: against the 1956 table, today's localities give Northern + River Nile 493,880 km² (+3.7 %), Kassala + Gedaref + Red Sea 323,408 km² (−3.3 %), Khartoum 21,195 km² (−24.8 %; 28,165 km² still in 1983, 22,142 km² after 1994), Blue Nile group 142,471 km² (+2.4 %) — while Kordofan (+0.4 %) and Darfur (−0.5 %), whose lines are not reported to have moved, agree. So the 1994 states are not all subsets of the 1948 provinces here (statoids itself: «most, but not all»), and the old lines run inside today's localities (Ad Damar, Al Buhaira, Sharg An Neel, Al Butanah …).
